findings.claim: The align-items mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which is not a real CSS property in any IE/Edge version. IE10/11 use `-ms-flex-align`, which the mixin already emits on line 120, so the `-ms-align-items` line is dead output.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:117-123, the newly added align-items mixin emits -ms-align-items on line 121 alongside -ms-flex-align on line 120 and align-items on line 122. No version of IE or Edge ever supported -ms-align-items (IE10/11 recognize -ms-flex-align and IE11+/Edge use standard align-items), making line 121 dead CSS output.

findings.claim: The order mixin passes `$val` directly to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` and `-moz-box-ordinal-group`. Those legacy properties are 1-based, while `order` is 0-based, so ordering in older WebKit/Firefox is off by one, and a value of 0 is invalid.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:125-131, @mixin order($val) passes $val directly to -webkit-box-ordinal-group (line 126) and -moz-box-ordinal-group (line 127) without offsetting by +1. Since legacy box-ordinal-group is 1-based (initial value 1, requiring positive integers per the 2009 Flexbox draft and legacy WebKit) while order is 0-based, values are off by one relative to unstyled siblings and 0 is invalid.
